description: Sends the claim mail for an unclaimed site. site_id and site_token are the values from the deploy reply. email is the address that receives the mail. The site stays unclaimed until the link in the mail is opened. Does not charge. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

email.description: The address the claim mail is sent to.

site_id.description: The site id from the deploy reply.

site_token.description: The site token from the deploy reply.

name: send_claim_mail
